Did Charleston Shooter Dylann Roof Have Help Writing Manifesto?

Sixteen hours after killing nine people inside a Charleston, South Carolina, church, 21-year-old Dylann Roof was treated to a free meal from Burger King by the Shelby, North Carolina, police officers who arrested him.
This is according to Shelby Police Chief Jeff Ledford, who told the Charlotte _Observer_ that Roof complained of hunger before officers bought him the burger.
Turns out he only had time for a single bag of chips while leading police on a manhunt.
